items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: He used to be with Cab Calloway.

ctx.x: That's not -- yeah, but that's not exactly what I meant, the question. I meant -- when you had mentioned started, before you developed what became known for, when you first started playing, do you remember what bass players you were listening to?
Oh, yes. Well, (inaudible), of course, and, oh, let's see. There's another bass player. I forget his name. He used to be with Cab Calloway. Green -- Green something. (Al Morgan)
Yeah, we can look his name up. We've got those records books in there, big --
